products.what_it_changes: OEM-replacement intake valve for a top-end/valve job. One-piece forged Ti3Al titanium with CrN coating for surface hardness and lower friction; ProX says it meets or exceeds OE dimensions. Restores valve sealing and clearance stability when the stock valves are worn or recessed.
products.supporting_parts: Usually replaced as a set (2 intake valves per head) with valve seals, and seats/guides checked or re-cut; check springs at the same time. Exhaust side is a separate part.
products.caveats: ProX's fitment tab lists makes, models and years as separate filters, not as paired rows. All listed models are Honda CRF250R/RX, so pairing is low risk. The page shows no OEM cross-reference number. Honda changed the CRF250R engine for 2022; ProX lists one valve for 2018-2026, so confirm against the OEM part number before ordering.

products.what_it_changes: Higher-rate dual chromium-silicon springs with titanium or heat-treated steel retainers. They control the valves at high rpm and support more lift than stock springs: the listing gives 0.450 in lift, 204 lb intake and 165 lb exhaust open pressure, and 60/50 lb seat pressure. Used with hotter cams or for high-rpm race engines.
products.supporting_parts: Valve keepers are not listed in the kit contents. Check installed height and coil bind if fitting higher-lift cams.
products.caveats: The fitment table is from a UK dealer (Ghostbikes), not Kibblewhite's own site. The title says 2021-2023, but the table also lists the 2020 KX 250 F. Spring figures are as the dealer printed them.

products.what_it_changes: Aluminium braces that stop the radiators bending and twisting in a crash or tip-over without blocking airflow. The dealer says they work with the radiator fan.

products.caveats: No maker part number is printed on the dealer page. Its installation file is named '11-5019_Instructions.pdf', and 11-5019 appears on EE's own brace page (https://www.enduroeng.com/p143486-brace), but EE does not print fitment there, so the part number is not confirmed. The finish is not stated.

gaps: Mishimoto: the MX catalogue (mishimoto.com /fits/ and the MX/ATV hose and radiator pages) shows only dirt-bike radiators and hose kits up to about 2014 (e.g. CRF450R 2002-2008, YZ450F 2010-2013, YZ125 2005-2014). No 2020+ roster bike was found.
Fluidyne: fluidyne.com lists only car and race-car radiators. Fluidyne Powersports MX radiators appear only in 2009-2011 press items. No current dirt-bike line or 2020+ fitment was found.

CV4: no maker site was found. Dealer pages (Cycle Gear, RevZilla, JJ Motorsports) show CV4 hose kits only up to about 2016 for MX bikes (plus CRF150R) and print no colour or part-number variants. No 2020+ roster fitment, so no CV4 silicone hose colours could be recorded.

Psychic: appears to be an Australian brand sold by Firestorm Motorcycles. The only listings found were older radiators (e.g. WR250 2015-2018, CRF450R 2002-2008). No 2020+ roster radiator or hose kit was found.

Enduro Engineering: enduroeng.com lists radiator brace part numbers 11-017 to 11-8018 and guard part numbers 12-1116 to 12-9025 (12-1116BK; the 3/16 in guards are black anodised), but prints no make/model/year per part number. Dealers say 12-1116 fits '2016-2024 KTM/Husqvarna/GasGas' (Walmart title only).

Web Cams (webcamshafts.com): grinds are listed for KTM 450 SXF DOHC (62-011, 62-121, 62-021), KTM 250 SXF DOHC (62-082 / 62-072), CRF450R SOHC (59-912, 59-982, 59-992, 67-232) and CRF250R SOHC (57-092, 57-522, 57-312, 67-242). Spring kits VC-K41 (Kibblewhite) and VC-K52 are listed for the KTM 450 SXF SOHC. No model years are printed, so these are not recorded as fits.

Hot Cams / Vertex: no Hot Cams camshaft was found for any 2023+ roster four-stroke. Newest found: CRF450R 2017-2020 Stage 1/2 (dealer title only), KTM-group 250 to 2021/22, YZ450F 2018-2019. ProX YZ450F '23 exhaust valve 28.2453-1 exists, but its page and the matching intake could not be opened.
not_done: hotcams.com, mishimoto.com/powersports and cv4.com: fetch requests were not approved or timed out, so they were not read.

Several pro-x.com pages could not be opened (category pages 2-5, the YZ450F '23 exhaust valve page, and the KTM350EXC-F/FE350 steel exhaust valve page). As a result, ProX 2023+ valves for the KTM 450 SX-F, KTM 250 SX-F, YZ450F, KX250/KX450 and CRF450R exhaust were not captured with part numbers.
vertexpistons.com (the Hot Cams parent company's catalogue) redirected, and the redirect fetch was not approved. na.vertexpistons.com is blocked by robots.txt.
partseurope.eu (Kibblewhite and CV4 product pages 09262359, 09261696 and 19021829) loads fitment with JavaScript, so no fitment could be read.
rockymountainatvmc.com is blocked by bot protection (Incapsula).
Kibblewhite: no maker-site pages were found. Kibblewhite 2023+ spring kits for KTM, Yamaha and Kawasaki 450s were not found on any source with a fitment table.
No radiator fans were found from the listed brands for roster bikes.
8 fitment years outside the BAK MX roster were left out when merged (2026-10-17).
